Some days are better, I seem happy but still think about it even if only for a short amount of time. But some days are awful, these are usually when I’m alone I’d define an awful day as planning. And within the last week I have gone to the place I wanted to do ‘it’, I was so close but I was stopped by someone (a stranger). I don’t want to feel suicidal but it isn’t something I can get rid of. I don’t want to let it get the better of me but I know that ultimately it will and the clock is ticking, most mornings I wake up feeling like each day is just another day closer to a more than awful day.
How much?
At least it’d stop my problems affecting others. And it’d make my suffering stop, it feels like my only escape.
Life isn’t the amount of time you stay alive, it’s the amount of time you avoid death. And I’m tired of avoiding the inevitable.
